record.reason: PUMA prunes MLLM layers with self-distillation to cut inference cost, but the target task is unified multimodal retrieval and the pruning is tied to retrieval quality rather than a general LLM serving or decoding mechanism, so the inference-system contribution is indirect.
record.title: PUMA: Layer-Pruned Language Model for Efficient Unified Multimodal Retrieval with Modality-Adaptive Learning
